statement: When whether the caller may read a change cannot be decided (a store or snapshot read fails), every step that names it is a 503, for a change that exists and for one that does not; 404 stays for a change that does not exist or that the caller may not read.
guards: control:ControlRoundTwoFixesTest#a change whose readability cannot be decided is a 503 at every step, whether or not it exists
